body: IGN's weapons guide (updated November 18, 2026) lists the Combat Knife as a melee weapon of the Knife type.
IGN names it among its melee weapon types: Baseball Bat, Hunting Knife, Bushcraft Knife, EDC Knife, Diving Knife, Switchblade, Combat Knife, Survival Knife, Brass Knuckles and Baton.
Disagreement: IGN says there are nine melee weapon types and that 9 melee weapons count toward a full arsenal, but its list names ten; PowerPyx's Progress database also counts 9.
IGN gives no stats, maker, price or location for it.
